notes: Reading issues, events, stacktraces, tags, breadcrumbs, and
releases runs automatically. Creating a release or commenting on
an issue is write-tier — confirm before the first write. Archiving
an issue is modify-tier because it hides the issue from default
views. Resolving, ignoring, or deleting an issue is
destructive-tier because these actions hide the issue from future
investigations. Unlisted actions are bumped one tier above the
conservative default per the design doc §6.
